description:
Durable Frame /Suspension Fork

Built with a rugged high-carbon steel frame and reinforced front suspension fork. Conquers bumps with ease while delivering maximum control and durability on demanding terrain.

Precision 18-Speed Shifting

*Take command with 18 smooth-shifting speeds. Effortlessly adapt to hills, flats, or your preferred pace for a truly versatile ride experience.*

Hybrid Performance: City to Trail

Your go-anywhere companion. Perfect for relaxed urban commutes and ready for scenic trails – transitions seamlessly between pavement and light off-road adventures.

Trusted V-Brakes for Safety

Dependable V-brakes deliver strong, reliable stopping power. Simple to maintain and adjust – ideal for beginners mastering control in any environment.

Find Your Perfect Fit

Designed for men & women. Choose your size: 26" wheels fit riders 5'4"–5'9", 27.5" wheels fit 5'8"–6'5". Ride comfortably with the right setup.

Conquer any terrain with the Hiland Agave 2 Mountain Bike. Featuring a 18-speed drivetrain, dual V brakes, and a durable suspension fork for ultimate control.
